title: Sidebar UI: patch overlay toggle + shader mode + model switcher
description:
Right-side HUD sidebar in MeshNodeViewerScene for interactive patch-decomposition inspection and model switching. Depends on VIEW-5 (tagged rendering) and VIEW-6 (staging dir + catalog).

Components:
1. ModelCatalog (new class): scans ~/.ix/ixdar-models/ (or IXDAR_MODEL_DIR), returns list of ModelEntry(displayName, type, absolutePath). Display names prefix DSL/OBJ and show subdirectory structure.

2. SidebarPanel (new class): non-modal HUD on the right edge. Borrows hover/click/scroll mechanics from MenuBox but positioned on the right and always visible. Sections:
   - Header: Patches ON/OFF button, Mode Lambert/Flat button (dim when Patches off)
   - Model list: row per ModelEntry, current highlighted, scroll wheel scrolls, click loads
   - Uses HyperString + Drawing.getDrawing().font.drawHyperString()

3. MeshNodeViewerScene wiring:
   - initGL() instantiates ModelCatalog, SidebarPanel
   - draw() renders 3D view then sidebar HUD
   - loadModel(ModelEntry): DSL → loadSourceAsync(DSL_FOLDER,...), OBJ → loadSourceAsync('obj',...); preserve orbit
   - togglePatchOverlay(): enable → SemanticPatchDecomposer.decompose(current mesh, 128); convert each Patch to a tag (name patch_N, color from Patch.color() for Welsh-Powell mode or PatchRenderer.uniquePatchColor(pid) for flat); setTags(); disable → clearTags()
   - toggleShaderMode(): flip Lambert↔Flat, rebuild tag-color registry, HalfEdgeMeshRuntime.setShaderMode()
   - decomposition cache keyed by mesh source path / vertex-array hash

4. Input in MeshViewerKeyGuy:
   - P → togglePatchOverlay
   - Shift+P → toggleShaderMode
   - [/] → loadModel(catalog.prev()/next())
   - Mouse routed to sidebar.setHover()/click() before 3D view

Acceptance goal: orbit skull, press P, zoom into dentition, flip to flat shader — can we see individual teeth as distinct colors? The core diagnostic question that motivated the entire PATCH epic from VOYAGE-51 onwards.
definition-of-done: Viewer launches with sidebar on right. Model list shows DSLs + voyage OBJs + Blends OBJs from the staging dir. Click switches models, orbit preserved. P toggles overlay, Shift+P toggles shader mode. Zooming into skull dentition under flat mode reveals whether teeth are separate patches or visually merged — answers the PATCH-8 open question.
testing-plan: (1) mvn -P game, skull visible. (2) Click voyage_skull_ref.obj in sidebar, press P. Cranium visibly subdivided under Welsh-Powell. (3) Shift+P for flat. (4) Zoom into teeth. (5) [/] cycles models; Click to load Blends OBJ; orbit preserved. (6) Z-key wireframe still works; no regression on DSL load without patches.
